title: La transition agro-écologique des agricultures du Sud
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: Food security, jobs, ecological transition of production and consumption modes and more One of the seventeen Sustainable Development Goals, agro-ecology could be one solution for meeting the forthcoming challenges for humanity. Cirad and AFD set out their thoughts on agro-ecology as a means for Southern agricultural systems to adapt to global change and on conditions for a successful agro-ecological transition.
